messages.cta.lead: The Windows installer bundles a JRE; ZIP packages require Java 17. Complete administrator and network setup on first launch.
messages.cta.step1.body: Install *-win-x64-setup.exe, or fully extract the Java ZIP. Keep plugins/ and run run.bat or sh run.sh from that directory.
messages.cta.step1.title: Download and start
messages.cta.step2.body: Set your administrator username, password, and proxy at /setup.html, then open the download page.
messages.cta.step2.title: First-time setup
messages.cta.step3.body: Sign in, open /pixiv-batch.html and add a work. Confirm task completion and saved files, then open the gallery. Install the companion userscript to add tasks from Pixiv pages.
messages.cta.step3.title: Use pixiv-batch directly
messages.cta.title: Three steps, and you're running.
messages.features.f1.body: Save images, convert Ugoira to selected animation formats, or save novels as TXT, HTML or EPUB. Galleries display works registered in the database.
messages.features.f1.title: Illustrations, manga, ugoira and novels
messages.features.f2.body: Sidebar nav / three-mode tag-author filtering / lightbox / prev-next chapter / related works / same-artist works. Browsable locally the moment a download finishes.
messages.features.f2.title: Local gallery + artwork detail
messages.features.f3.body: Collections with custom icons and per-collection download roots. File-name templates: {artwork_id}_p{page}, {author_name}, {R18+} and more.
messages.features.f3.title: Collections + custom templates
messages.features.f4.body: Solo / multi modes. Each UUID gets its own quota in multi mode; over-quota downloads are zipped as archives. Issue invite codes scoped to tags / authors / age ratings.
messages.features.f4.title: Multi-user · quota · invite codes
messages.features.f5.body: The interface supports multiple languages, dark and light themes, and remembers your chosen theme.
messages.features.f5.title: Dark mode + i18n
messages.features.f6.body: The database stores work IDs, titles, folders, formats, ratings, AI flags and tags. The desktop interface provides status, settings, image classification, directory checks and data backfill tools.
messages.features.f6.title: Work database and desktop tools
messages.features.title: Download, organize and read your works.
